description: Establishes the immovable reference point from which all other cards are measured. Cannot be displaced by standard Override unless tier ≥ III.
Absorbs adjacent card effects without propagating them. Useful as a buffer or silence zone in dense constraint grids.
Supersedes any single non-Hard constraint in play. Resolved before standard card actions in the same phase.
Places a detainment token on target card. Detained cards cannot move, trigger, or propagate until token is removed.
Advances all Temporal domain cards by one phase-step. Interacts with AccretionEngine to compound phase acceleration.
Projects a spatial constraint zone affecting all cards within two grid positions. Cards inside cannot be Overridden below tier II.
Gains +0.5 accretion_weight each round it remains in play. At weight 5.0 it auto-resolves into a Singularity card.
Allows one card per phase to cross domain boundaries without triggering constraint checks. Closes after three uses.
Duplicates the last resolved card's effect at half magnitude. Cannot echo another Echo (no recursive loops).
Destroys all Soft constraint tokens in play. Detained cards within range are released. Triggers AccretionEngine reset.
Propagates a physical-domain signal to all adjacent Somatic cards, triggering their passive abilities simultaneously.
Raises field_strength of all Affective domain cards in play by +1 until the next phase reset.
Sets an absolute upper bound on any numeric property (weight, strength, priority) for all cards in the active zone.
Links two Social domain cards. Linked cards share field_strength; if one is Detained, both are affected.
Establishes a causal dependency: card A must resolve before card B. Breaking the thread triggers a Void Surge at half magnitude.
Represents a discrete material object. Can be combined (Accretion) or destroyed (Void) depending on adjacent card interactions.
Freezes all Temporal domain cards in place for two full phases. Immune to standard Override (requires tier III Override or Void Surge).
Creates a logical dependency map. Any card that violates a lattice-defined rule is automatically Detained.
The simplest initiation card. Fires once and is removed from play. Triggers one adjacent card's primary ability.
Applies Override to every non-Hard-constraint card in the active zone simultaneously. Resolves in phase-order priority.
A hard-null card that blocks all propagation across its position. Neither field_strength nor effects can cross it.
Passively records every card resolution within its zone. Its log can be read to reconstruct prior game states.
Wraps target card in a material layer. Each layer adds +0.3 to that card's field_strength and +0.2 to accretion_weight.
Applies a non-expiring detainment. Only a tier-III Override or Void Surge can lift it. Increases target's constraint_class to Hard.
Moves a card from its current phase position to any other phase position in the active timeline without triggering in-between effects.
Creates a bounded echo loop between two designated cards. The loop runs for exactly three iterations then collapses into the Null state.
Applies a shared constraint to all cards in a Social Weave link. If any linked card is Overridden, all others receive an Override notification.
Inverts the field_strength of all Elemental domain cards (positive becomes negative and vice versa) for one full phase.
A somatic variant of The Anchor. Fixes all Somatic domain cards in their current state. Immune to Flux Wave and Liminal Gate.
Overrides the behavioral rule of a Cognitive Lattice without destroying it. The lattice continues operating under the new rule.
Detains an Affective domain card, preventing Affective Bloom and all emotional propagation through it for two phases.
The terminal accretion state. Cannot be Detained or Overridden. Resolves the entire active zone and resets the board to baseline.
